messages.plaintextBody:
Hi James,

Our records show approximately 9.5 hours of unposted time for the week commencing 27 April. Please post your time by Friday so we can finalise the April WIP run. Matters with the largest gaps are flagged in the attached summary on the finance portal.

Thanks,
Accounts
